# netraom-graph-writer (demo vendored subset)

Copied from the Netraom monorepo for standalone student use. Includes only:

- `backends/networkx_mem.py`
- `combo/engine.py`, `combo/patterns.py`, `combo/subgraph.py`

Production graph-writer also merges S3 curated data and writes Neptune/Neo4j snapshots.

See [../README.md](../README.md) for provenance.
